C. A. 8th Cir. Certiorari granted, eases consolidated, and a total of one hour allotted for oral argument.

Justice O’Connor took no part in the consideration or decision of these petitions.

Reported below: Nos. 97-826 (first judgment), 97-829 (first judgment), 97-830, 97-831 (first judgment), 97-1075, 97-1087, 97-1099, and 97-1141,120 F. 3d 753; Nos. 97-826, 97-829, and 97-831 (second judgments), 124 F. 3d 934.
